I was looking for an inexpensive pocket hole jig to do just a few holes for a small project. I found this one, with everything you need for doing the job. It works great! the drill bit is sharp and decent quality, the jig body is high-density plastic and handles the clamping very well. The vice grips are not super high quality, but they are pretty good and do what they're supposed to do. I don't know how durable everything will be long term, but I see no reason for this kit to not keep working for many years into the future.

We purchased this VEVOR 3-Tier Pastry Display Case for use in our General Store, and overall, we are very pleased with it. It looks professional on the countertop and does a great job of displaying our baked goods and treats while keeping everything organized and easily accessible. The clear acrylic provides excellent visibility, and the three-tier design makes good use of counter space. The rear access doors are convenient for staff, and the removable shelves make cleaning and rearranging products much easier. The only drawback is that the display case is not airtight. While it provides a nice enclosed display area, products can still dry out over time, so you need to be mindful of how long baked goods are left inside. A better seal around the doors would be a welcome improvement. That being said, for the price, this is an excellent display case. It looks great, serves its purpose well, and is a practical addition to our restaurant. Definitely worth 5 stars! Just be aware that it is a display case rather than an airtight storage container.

I bought this display case to sell baked goods at my local farmers market, and it has been a great investment. It is sturdy, easy to assemble, keeps flies off the food, and looks great.

The display case looks great and was easy to assemble. Overall, I am happy with the product, but the quality control could definitely be improved. Unfortunately, the package was missing two screws and one nut. One of the door hinges was bent, as if it had been damaged during manufacturing or shipping. In addition, both magnetic door catches fell off because they were attached with very weak glue. I had to glue them back myself. These are small issues, but they should not happen with a new product. I hope VEVOR improves its quality control in the future.
